title: Probability Lab Core
purpose: Create a speculation and forecasting layer that turns tracker signals into scenario probabilities, confidence bands, trigger lists and update history.
boundary: This is a probability system, not certainty. It records assumptions, evidence, confidence and triggers. Forecasts must change when source data changes.
principles: Every forecast needs signals, weight, confidence and update triggers.
Predictions must be versioned so the site can show what changed and why.
A low-confidence forecast must be labelled low confidence.
No forecast becomes a claim of fact without verified records.

engineStages.name: Signal intake
engineStages.description: Collect source routes, verified records, filing metadata, news items, public-contract routes, regulator routes and missing-record updates.

engineStages.name: Classification
engineStages.description: Classify each input by topic, source type, freshness, reliability, affected layer and direction of impact.

engineStages.name: Scenario modelling
engineStages.description: Create competing scenarios rather than one fixed prediction.

engineStages.name: Probability weighting
engineStages.description: Assign probability bands based on source strength, signal count, trend direction and counter-evidence.

engineStages.name: Trigger watch
engineStages.description: List the events or records that would raise, lower or invalidate a scenario.

engineStages.name: Update log
engineStages.description: Keep every probability change with timestamp and reason.

probabilityBands.label: low probability
probabilityBands.meaning: Possible but weakly supported or contradicted by stronger signals.

probabilityBands.label: emerging possibility
probabilityBands.meaning: Some supporting signals exist, but the scenario remains uncertain.

probabilityBands.label: live contest
probabilityBands.meaning: Evidence is mixed or the outcome depends on near-term triggers.

probabilityBands.label: probable direction
probabilityBands.meaning: The signal set supports the scenario, with important caveats.

probabilityBands.label: strongly indicated
probabilityBands.meaning: Multiple strong signals align, but uncertainty remains.

probabilityBands.label: near certain only after confirmation
probabilityBands.meaning: Reserve for outcomes already effectively confirmed by official records or direct observation.
